extDescription.message: Select a word or line in subtitles on any streaming site and get its meaning in the context of the scene. Saved by show.

emptyPanel.message: Pick a session on the left or start a new one, then start watching...

emptyThread.message: This session is empty. Words you select will appear here...

deleteThreadConfirm.message: Delete "$TITLE$" and all of its words?

errorNoApiKey.message: No API key set. Add one in the extension settings.

errorInvalidKey.message: Your API key is invalid. Check it in the settings.

errorRateLimited.message: Too many requests. Wait a few seconds and try again.

errorNetwork.message: Connection problem. Check your internet and try again.

errorServer.message: Gemini is not responding right now. Try again later.

errorEmptyAnswer.message: Gemini returned an empty answer. Try again.

errorTimeout.message: The answer took too long. Check your connection and try again.

apiKeyHelpLink.message: Get a free one from Google AI Studio →

pauseOnSelectLabel.message: Pause the video when I start selecting

reviewDone.message: You got $CORRECT$ of $TOTAL$ right on the first try.

onboardingIntro.message: Cueword explains words by asking Gemini. That needs a free API key. It takes a minute.

onboardingStep1.message: Create your key in Google AI Studio.

onboardingStep2.message: Copy it and paste it in the settings.

onboardingStep3.message: Then just watch. When a word stops you, hold Alt and select it. (Option on Mac)
